definitions.explanation: A direction or position that is neither horizontal nor vertical.
Moving or positioned at an angle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{斜|なな}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{直|なお}して→直す：00869_naosu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The picture is crooked, so please fix it.

examples.japanese: {斜|なな}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{斜|なな}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。

examples.english: His house is diagonally across from the station.

notes:
{斜|なな}め functions as both a noun and a no-adjective (modifies nouns with の).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {斜|なな}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (diagonally - adverbial)
- {斜|なな}め⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (diagonally forward/ahead)
- {斜|なな}め⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧ (diagonally behind)
- {斜|なな}め⟦{向|む}かい→向かい：03750_mukai⟧ (diagonally opposite)

DIRECTIONAL EXPRESSIONS:
- {斜|なな}め⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧ (diagonally to the right)
- {斜|なな}め⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧ (diagonally to the left)
- {斜|なな}め⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧ (diagonally above)
- {斜|なな}め⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ (diagonally below)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {斜|なな}め vs. ⟦{傾|かたむ}いている→傾く：00200_katamuku⟧: ⟦{傾|かたむ}いている→傾く：00200_katamuku⟧ means "tilted/leaning" (from vertical); {斜|なな}め describes diagonal direction.

RELATED KANJI:
The kanji {斜|しゃ} is also read as しゃ in compounds like ⟦{傾斜|けいしゃ}→傾斜：05447_keisha⟧ (slope, inclination).

Register: Neutral. Common in everyday directions and descriptions.
